full_name: Robert Darnton | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2017–2018 History Joy Foundation Fellow Harvard University
bio: Robert Darnton is the Carl H. Pforzheimer University Professor and University librarian, emeritus, at Harvard University. After a brief stint as a reporter for the New York Times, he became a junior fellow in the Society of Fellows at Harvard. He taught at Princeton from 1968 until 2007, when he came to Harvard.
